name: Abatement
flavor: "It is a simple matter to strip all your nonsense away, and return the land to her folk!" -- Acornbelly, boasting to Fingle
text: Cast on square. Dispels all spells on square. Square becomes plains.

name: Back to Nature
flavor: "Goldleaf's treachery, however vile, shall not mark the fall of Nature! Come, loyal nymphs and playful dryads! Come, towering folk of the woods and courageous dwellers of the forest! Flourish throughout the land and restore this vile, sad world to her previous glory!" -- Acornbelly to the denizens of Nature
text: Cast on globe. Dispels all spells on globe.

name: Barkskin
flavor: Denizens of nature commonly develop hardened bark skin as they grow older, some finally losing themselves to become one with the forest.
text: Cast on minion. Minion gets +1 armor. May be cast more than once on the same minion.

name: Bellwether
flavor: "None of your artful befuddlements will fool the folk of Nature, while the kind-eyed Bellwether walks among us!" -- Acornbelly, boasting to Al Hakim
text: H:0(x0) A:0 HP:10 L:0 Cast on recruit group. Creates Pacified Cow, a Satyr swordsman. It does not attack. Its group cannot be targeted by enemy group spells, and cannot join other groups or add any new recruits.

name: Biting Wind
text: Cast on minion, even if it is concealed. Minion takes 2*M points of damage. Revolver (Casting cost M revolves from 1 to 10, starting at 1 and increasing by 1 mana per turn, restarting at 1 when it reaches 10, until cast).
castOn: minion, even if it is concealed

name: Deluge
flavor: "Shinies floated, bluemen walked, beards and shades on mountains stalked, in the endless rushing wave, heroes met a sodden grave" -- Human children's rhyme
text: Cast on globe. Affects all non-water squares adjacent to water squares. Affected squares become water for current turn +1, then change from water to plains. Duration: Turn of casting +1.

name: Diomesia
flavor: "Come, join in the vast dance of nature, drink from our skins and raise your voice with our pipes. Lose yourself, and join Nature." -- Call of Diomesia
text: H:0 A:0 HP:7 L:2 Cast on recruit group. Creates Diomesia, a Satyr Hero swordswoman. All swordsmen in her group and any opposing group do not deal hand damage. (Each Hero may be cast only once per game.)

name: Druid
text: Cast on archer. Archer gets +1 missile damage, and cannot be targeted by individual Abomination or Mind spells. If archer's group is in forest, Druid generates +1 World for group owner each turn.

name: Dryad's Favors
flavor: Dryads are peaceful folk who rely on seduction and guile. Those bewitched by dryads often disappear for days, returning with no memory of what happened.
text: Cast on recruit. Recruit is removed from the game. At start of turn of casting +3, one new recruit of the same nation and class is created in square. (Group is created if square is unoccupied, or on the earliest turn thereafter.).

name: Eagle Eyes
text: Cast on friendly recruit. All friendly archers in squares adjacent to recruit get +1 missile damage.

name: Earthquake
text: Cast on square. Target square becomes barren land. Colonies in the four adjacent squares are destroyed. Each minion in the four adjacent squares takes 0-4 hit points of damage.

name: Forestation
flavor: "While you erect battlements and halls of stone, we dwell in the great hall of Nature!" -- Acornbelly, boasting to Belvario
text: Cast on square. Square becomes forest. (Minions in forest cannot be targeted by enemy individual spells.)

name: Fusillade
text: Cast on group with archers. Archers in group get +1 attack in combat round 1 only.

name: Gale Force
text: Cast on globe. All groups move twice this turn in their direction of travel.

name: Geomancy
flavor: There have ever been cycles of climatic change. Geomancy simply hastens Nature's abundant renewal.
text: Cast on globe. All non-structure terrain is randomly regenerated, according to the realm of the current game.

name: Goldcaps
flavor: "Goldcaps are the spirits of autumn, born to frolic a moment, then gladly die -- for each one that dies turns a tree leaf gold." -- Uyden's Handbook
text: H:1 A:0 HP:3(x3) L:0 Territorial. Neutral. Creates three Goldcaps. Goldcaps attack all groups, even if friendly.

name: Hailstorm
text: Cast on square. Affects square and all adjacent squares. At start of turn, all minions in affected squares take 1 hit point of damage. Duration: Turn of casting +2.

name: Healing Spring
flavor: "He struck the ground with his Dythramb, laughing, and a spring of fresh water immediately bubbled forth, wholesome and clear." -- Kyman Firth, "The Siege of Groven's Weald"
text: Cast on square. When group enters square, all members of group are fully healed.

name: Huntsman
flavor: Those beloved of Nature may find themselves crowned with antlers, gifted with sight, and made to stand against those who would encroach upon her bower.
text: H:3 A:2 HP:10 L:2 Territorial. Gets +2 hand damage against monsters.

name: Icecaps
text: H:1 A:1 HP:1(x3) L:1 Nomadic, Neutral. Creates three Icecaps. When Icecaps' group dies, group's square becomes ice.

name: Ill Winds
flavor: The Winds Ventrius, Borundo, Celyph, and Autrenith are the oldest and mightiest of the Unseelie Horde.
text: Cast on town or colony. Affects town and the four adjacent squares. Minions in squares deal no missile damage (before checking armor).

name: Inundate
flavor: Even beneath the desert, in thousand hidden rivulets and channels, water awaits the call to surge forth.
text: Cast on square. Square becomes water. (Each minion drowns (dies) in water when water is created, when minion enters square, at start of turn, before movement, and before combat, unless minion has Waterwalk. Water blocks movement unless group has Waterwalk.)

name: Jade Dragon
flavor: The Dragon Zhe was born to guard the woodland lakes. When Goldleaf betrayed Nature, Zhe swore her daughters would dedicate themselves to destroying what Goldleaf had unleashed into the world.
text: H:4(x2) A:1 HP:15 L:2 Waterwalk. Two attacks. Target square becomes water. At start of combat against Imps, kills one random opposing Imp. At start of turn, is removed from the game.

name: Jaguar's Blood
flavor: He who bathes in the Jaguar's Blood takes on the vigor and spirit of the great cat.
text: Cast on minion. Minion gets +4 maximum and current hit points.

name: Karillian Arrows
flavor: Satyr archers cultivate the poison from the glands of these venomous Karillian tree frogs; they use a distillate to tip their arrows.
text: Cast on archer. When archer damages an opponent, opponent gets an effect that gives 1 hit point of damage at the start of each round for the rest of that combat.

name: Lightning Bolt
flavor: "The skies themselves roiled at our approach, and then the great lightning struck not far away ..." -- Kyman Firth, "The Siege of Groven\'s Weald"
text: Cast on minion. Minion takes five hit points of damage.

name: Natural Order
text: Cast on square. Dispels all square spells in the 3x3 diamond centered on square. This does not change terrain or destroy colonies.

name: Overflow
text: Cast on friendly town or colony adjacent to at least one non-structure, non- water square, and not adjacent to any enemy minions. Up to two random adjacent non-structure squares become water. (Each minion drowns (dies) in water when water is created, when minion enters square, at start of turn, before movement, and before combat, unless minion has Waterwalk. Water blocks movement unless group has Waterwalk.)
castOn: friendly town or colony adjacent to at least one non-structure, non- water square, and not adjacent to any enemy minions

name: Pixie Dust
flavor: "Pixies are the tiniest of Nature's minions, but a handful in your hair are enough to incapacitate your entire company." -- Uyden's Handbook
text: Cast on minion. All other members of minion's group get -2 hand damage.

name: Primeval Forest
flavor: Deep in the heart of the primeval forest lies the Great Tree of Life. In times of need the Forest Elders stir from their rest to defend this sacred stand.
text: Cast on forest. Affects all contiguous forest squares. Every monster created in Primeval Forest gets Primeval Strength (+1 hand damage).

name: Protective Cover
flavor: "Wild wood! These changed ones are no longer your children! In the fight tomorrow, O branches, O thorns -- trip and tangle, strike and strangle!" -- Diomesia in her cups
text: Cast on recruit. Recruit no longer attacks, and receives no combat damage. When recruit is hit by an Imp (before checking armor), the Imp receives the damage instead, ignoring armor. Dispelled after next combat.

name: Revelers
flavor: Every revel has its price.
text: Cast on recruit group. All members of group lose their natural house abilities.

name: Seed on the Wind
flavor: "The dancing ripple from a pebble's strike -- The seed alighting in a patch of sand -- Begins a wave that bursts a city's dike -- Begins a pine that seeds a desert land" -- Song of the Satyrs
text: Cast on square. The 3x3 diamond centered on square becomes forest. (Minions in forest cannot be targeted by enemy individual spells.)

name: Sign of Order
flavor: "In all of Nature's promulgation some design / Faint, inscrutable, yet sure discerned / Penetrates the whole, drives fuse through flower / Requires the sparrow's taking of the worm" -- Song of the Satyrs
text: Cast on globe. Caster gets +1 Order each turn. May be cast more than once.

name: Simian Warriors
flavor: "Structural similarities suggest that Simians and Humans share a common ancestry, though neither group is eager to acknowledge this theory." -- Zaduth-Jar, Lecturer in Xenology
text: H:3 A:1 HP:7 L:1, H:1 A:0 HP:3 L:2, H:2 A:0 HP:5 L:1 Territorial. Creates three different Simian Warriors.

name: Smell the Roses
text: Cast on recruit group. Group becomes computer-controlled, cannot join groups or create new recruits, and moves like a territorial monster within the 3x3 diamond centered on group's square at time of casting. Duration: Turn of casting +2.

name: Stone Circle
flavor: The harmonics of living Stone can be used by the clever Geomancer. Dwarven stonesmiths have tried to duplicate the effect through engineering, with no success.
text: Cast on square. Square and its occupants cannot be targeted by any spells. While in square, minions in square get +1 level.

name: Straight-Arrow
text: Cast on archer. Archer gets +4 missile damage in combat round 1 only.

name: Syzygy
flavor: "There is a moment, then, in every life -- and wild lives teem in the abundant green -- when chance alignments of the great and small -- reveal the Pattern seldom seen" -- Song of the Satyrs
text: Cast on globe. Next turn, caster has all spell casting costs adjusted by -1 primary and -1 secondary mana per spell.

name: Tornado
flavor: "Winds roared, the ground exploded, the trees fell into the sky! These Satyrs really know how to entertain a guest!" -- Elevava Glasshead, Misfit traveler
text: Cast on square. Square's terrain is moved to a random adjacent non-structure square. Square becomes barren land.

name: Tree Man
flavor: Of Thumofol, it is said that he never died, but mossy and oaken himself, became one with the great wood, there to slumber until needed again.
text: H:3 A:1 HP:12 L:1 Territorial. Cast on forest.

name: Unseelie Howl
text: Cast on recruit group. Group's movement orders are cancelled. Every friendly recruit group's movement orders are cancelled.

name: Uproot
text: H:3 A:1 HP:12(x3) L:1 Nomadic. Cast on forest. Target square becomes barren land. Creates 3 Uprooted Tree Men. When Uprooted group dies, group's square becomes forest.

name: Utaban Brothers
text: H:2 A:1 HP:7 L:1 or M:2 A:0 HP:7 L:1 Cast on friendly recruit group in a structure. Creates a Satyr recruit of random class.
castOn: friendly recruit group in a structure

name: Water Breathing
flavor: Under the protection of the Naiads, travelers may move silently through their underwater grottos.
text: Cast on group. Group gains Waterwalk. (Group may cross water, and does not drown in water.)

name: Water's Gift
text: Cast on friendly town or colony. The four squares adjacent to structure become ice.

name: Watersniper
text: Cast on archer. Archer gets +1 missile damage, and its group gains Waterwalk. (Group may cross water, and does not drown in water.)

name: Will o' the Wisp
flavor: "Finally on the third day they came stumbling over the hill. We asked them where they had been. 'We followed a light,' they told us." -- Diary of Vlad Hrothgar
text: Cast on recruit group not in a structure. Group disappears for turn of casting +2. (Group reappears at start of turn if its square is unoccupied, or on the earliest turn thereafter.)
castOn: recruit group not in a structure

name: Wolf Pack
flavor: When necessary, the wolves themselves may be summoned to guard against those who would encroach upon the sanctity of the forest.
text: H:3 A:0 HP:12(x3) L:1 Territorial. Cast on forest. Creates three Wolves.

name: Woodhenge
text: Cast on forest. Square and its occupants cannot be targeted by any spells. Duration: Turn of casting +1.

name: World Dance
flavor: "How pale and sickly your clarity looks in comparison, when the Diomesian throng of revelers sweeps past!" -- Acornbelly, boasting to Lienna
text: Cast on town or colony. World Dance generates +2 World for town owner each turn.
